title: Billing Method Statement: Grant Conditions and Amount of a Utility Leak Adjustment
content:
# Grant Conditions and Amount of a Leak Adjustment — Utility Services Program

The disputed line is the water usage line named by the most recent suspected-leak dispute in submitted status on the Utility Services Program account; the disputed usage is the usage billed on it. The decision date is the date the adjustment is decided. Days after a bill date are counted as calendar days starting the day after the bill date.

## Grant

A leak adjustment is granted when all three of the following hold; when any of these fails the credit is zero:

1. the disputed usage is at least the program's leak usage multiple times the usual water usage of a leak adjustment;
2. the leak was repaired by a maintenance work order completed no more than the program's leak repair period (in days) after the disputed line's bill date — the completion date is the leak repair date recorded on the dispute;
3. fewer leak adjustments than the program's annual limit were posted on the account fewer than twelve whole months before the decision date.

## Amount

- **Usual water usage of a leak adjustment** — the usage of the actual water reads dated fewer than four whole months before the decision date less the usage billed on the disputed line (the read of the disputed period), divided by the number of those reads less one, rounded to 3 decimals; each sum of recorded water usage is taken to 2 decimals.
- **Leak excess** — the disputed usage less the usual water usage of a leak adjustment, never below zero, rounded to 3 decimals.
- **Credit** — the program's leak adjustment credit share of the leak excess times the program's water rate per thousand gallons, rounded half up to the cent. The credit is posted against the disputed line.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures: leak multiple 2.5, repair period 20 days, annual limit 1, credit share 40%, water rate $8.00 — illustrative, not the program's figures)

Actual water reads in the four-month window: 3.10, 2.90 and 12.30 thousand gallons, the last being the disputed period's read; the disputed usage is 12.300.

- Usual usage: 18.30 less 12.30 is 6.00, divided by two is 3.000.
- Test 1: 12.300 is at least 2.5 times 3.000, which is 7.500 — met.
- Leak excess: 12.300 less 3.000 is 9.300.
- Credit: 40% of 9.300 times $8.00 is $29.76.

## Boundary cases on the same hypothetical figures

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| work order completed on the 20th day after the bill date | test 2 met |
| work order completed on the 21st day after the bill date | test 2 fails; credit $0.00 |
| one leak adjustment posted on the account eleven months before the decision date | test 3 fails; credit $0.00 |
| disputed usage 7.400 against a usual usage of 3.000 | test 1 fails; credit $0.00 |
